card.title: US MILITARY RESEARCH
card.text: Choose one - add DEPTH CHARGES to hand OR add EXPANDED US RESEARCH to hand.
card.flavorText: No war has been more affected by advances in science and technology than WWII, and not only did it affect the outcome of the war but it also had a great effect on the civilian population after the war. The American invention of a small device called the cavity magnetron, which generates microwaves, greatly improved radar technology and would change how Americans prepared and consumed food after the war. The first mass production of Penicillin was done by American pharmaceutical companies prior to D-Day and it would help reduce the number of deaths and amputations of Allied troops during WWII. American aviation technology would also take great leaps, f.ex. the American B-29 bombers became the first aircraft that was equipped with the pressurized cabin system which allowed them to fly at much higher altitudes than before.
